reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and date-adjustment helpers, but shares only pieces of the occurrence policy rather than its complete application.

duplication.why: The daily skip-versus-shift decision is repeated in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, and getDatesInRange.

placement.why: Holiday matching and date adjustment belong in shared/schedules.ts, but the handlers also own occurrence-policy orchestration that should be shared.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested scheduling rules, range handler, supporting types, and tests.

maintainability.why: The small helpers are understandable, but future policy changes require coordinating multiple dispatch implementations and separate occurrence-search bounds.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts: getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange reproduce the adjusted-occurrence policy implemented in shared/schedules.ts:getNextDate.

disguised_duplication.where: The same daily non-working-day exclusion and otherwise-shift policy appears as find plus early return in getNextDate, filter/map in getUpcomingDates, and continue plus ternary in getDatesInRange.

abstraction_drift.where: Both existing weekend-adjustment helpers gain a holidays parameter; getNextDate gains a daily-only branch, while getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange independently implement that policy.
